brief.title: Public Foundation Release Brief
brief.decision: Approve the first Apache 2.0 foundation release candidate.
brief.summary: The RhoeLiquid foundation repo is ready for final public release certification once release hygiene, documentation, examples, and initial commit sequencing are complete.

actions.title: Keep examples source-first
actions.detail: Keep each template, JSON context, render script, and canonical output together in the Examples gallery.

actions.title: Preserve clean initial history
actions.detail: Complete final certification before creating the clean initial repository history.

actions.title: Prepare Homebrew follow-through
actions.detail: Use the existing formula template only after the initial tag and checksum exist.

risks.description: Public users may expect more framework-specific examples after the initial gallery.
Canonical outputs must be regenerated when template behavior intentionally changes.
